verification_levels.indexed: Identity/category membership is established, but mechanics or acquisition details are not fully verified.
verification_levels.partially_verified: Some important fields are independently checked; unresolved fields remain explicit.
verification_levels.verified: Required fields have been checked against sufficiently authoritative sources and no known conflicts remain.
verification_levels.conflict: At least one important field has materially conflicting source claims and must not be presented as settled.

rule: Verification applies to individual claims/fields as well as records. A record may remain partially verified when its identity is certain but one or more mechanics, costs, rewards or unlock conditions remain unresolved.
